facts.fact: At its 21 March 2025 session INEGE proposed to the Consejo Nacional de Estadistica a resolution creating the scientific committee of the V Censo General de Poblacion y Viviendas 2025.
facts.system: V Censo General de Poblacion y Viviendas 2025

facts.fact: At its 21 March 2025 session the Consejo Nacional de Estadistica heard INEGE present the degree of implementation of the ENDE in 2024 and the 2025 annual action plan.
